+def _sse_payload(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    data_pos = raw.find("data:")
+    if data_pos != -1 and (data_pos == 0 or raw[data_pos - 1] in "\r\n"):
+        data_start = data_pos + 5
+        next_lf = raw.find("\n", data_start)
+        next_cr = raw.find("\r", data_start)
+        if next_lf == -1:
+            data_end = next_cr
+        elif next_cr == -1:
+            data_end = next_lf
+        else:
+            data_end = next_cr if next_cr < next_lf else next_lf
+        raw_len = len(raw)
+        if data_end == -1:
+            data_end = raw_len
+        after = data_end
+        if after < raw_len:
+            if raw[after] == "\r" and after + 1 < raw_len and raw[after + 1] == "\n":
+                after += 2
+            else:
+                after += 1
+        single_data = after >= raw_len
+        if not single_data:
+            tail = raw[after]
+            if tail == "\n":
+                single_data = after + 1 == raw_len
+            elif tail == "\r":
+                single_data = after + 1 == raw_len or (
+                    after + 2 == raw_len and raw[after + 1] == "\n"
+                )
+        if single_data:
+            if (
+                data_start + 1 < data_end
+                and raw[data_start] == " "
+                and raw[data_start + 1] not in " \t"
+                and raw[data_end - 1] not in " \t"
+            ):
+                data_text = raw[data_start + 1 : data_end]
+            else:
+                data_text = raw[data_start:data_end].strip()
+            try:
+                parsed = json.loads(data_text) if data_text else {}
+                return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                return {"raw": data_text}
+
+    data_parts: list[str] = []
+
